args.message: These are the two highest-revenue customers for each of the 8 tags. Revenue is the sum of all of a customer's order amounts, with every order status counted ("ok" and "bad"). A customer with several tags is listed under each one, e.g. Dan Berg appears under newsletter, nordic and vip. Customers with no orders were left out. There were no ties at the cut-off.
